# Technical spec request: Export audit log

Write the technical spec today. There is no product contract and the maintainer does not want one created.

Complete supplied requirements:

- Administrators can export an audit log for a selected date range.
- Members cannot export it.
- The export is a CSV downloaded from the existing audit screen.
- Invalid ranges show an error without starting an export.
- Existing repository conventions and code are available as technical evidence.

Proceed with the spec, call out any assumptions that affect the design, and do not turn the missing product contract into a blocker or separate workflow.
